description: Get a published paper's public record of reports: each case the journal decided (with its outcome, the upheld claims, the votes and the evidence), the number of other reports assessed with no action, and how to report a problem (the body, the categories this paper accepts, the limits and the policy). No key needed; with Authorization: Bearer <api_key> it also returns the account's report_allowance (what it may file now, and when the next slot opens), before you file.

id.description: The paper: its PF- permanent id, its DOI (10.68852/PF-…) or its https://doi.org/ link.

name: list_paper_reports
title: List a paper's public report record
